note: Both sets are heavily duplicated, but Set A keeps the key values correct: optimal pitch is −1.0° and design/optimal TSR values are bound consistently. Set B states the optimal pitch as +1.0° (sign error), misattributes design/optimal values to the rotor, and includes fabricated or garbled quotes (e.g. 'The design point for this rotor pitch…', 'The design tip speed ratio for this blade…'). Both sets wrongly attach the 'set point tip-speed ratio' condition to the design-point TSR and pitch values, and A also mislabels the 8.5 optimal TSR as a design point. Overall A is more faithful and has fewer substantive errors.
